studies.label: Argumentative writing experiment: randomized first phase with a separately recruited nonrandom second phase

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 6, section 3.2; PDF p. 26, Table 3 column headings
counts_source.quote: 445 respondents who completed the session, 398 passed two embedded attention checks and were included in the final analysis ... Engage-to-Unlock Standard Chatbot Human-Only Time-Matched Unlock Total (107) (98) (99) (94) (398)

arms.name: Human-Only
arms.description: Randomized first-phase arm: writing without an AI assistant, using the common source readings.

arms.name: Standard Chatbot
arms.description: Randomized first-phase arm: Tell-me generative writing assistance available throughout.

arms.name: Engage-to-Unlock
arms.description: Randomized first-phase arm: Teach-me process guidance first; Tell-me became available after the draft expressed a position and a distinct supporting argumentative development. Participants explicitly selected Tell-me after unlocking.

arms.name: Time-Matched Unlock
arms.description: Nonrandom second-phase cohort, retained here to explain the printed overall study count. Teach-me first, with Tell-me scheduled from an earlier Engage-to-Unlock writer. All comparisons involving this arm are excluded from estimates.

studies.country: Canada; India; South Africa; United Kingdom; United States
studies.task: Write an argumentative essay about the four-day workweek using shared supportive and critical source summaries; the task qualifies through across-writer semantic dispersion.

ai_tool.name: gemini-3.1-pro-preview
ai_tool.locator: PDF p. 5, section 3.1; PDF p. 26, Appendix D. Both modes use the same model; the model release year is not stated.

preregistration.where: No preregistration is identified in the article or included appendices.

estimates.outcome: Within-condition semantic dispersion of final essays (D_c)
estimates.question: across_people
estimates.measure_detail: Complete final essays, after whitespace normalization, embedded using Gemini Embedding 2 with the SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY task type and 3,072 dimensions. D_c is the mean squared Euclidean distance to the condition centroid. Within-condition 95% percentile bootstrap intervals use 5,000 resamples.

sources.locator: PDF p. 13, Table 1, named condition rows
PDF p. 13, Table 1, dispersion-column heading
sources.quote: Mean Semantic Dispersion (𝐷𝑐) [95% Bootstrap CI]

sources.locator: PDF p. 9, section 3.5.3, Semantic Content and Dispersion
sources.quote: each complete final essay was embedded as a 3,072-dimensional vector using Gemini Embedding 2 with the SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY task type. ... We report 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals from 5,000 resamples

estimates.notes: The generic CI fields contain only the treatment-arm interval. The control-arm bootstrap interval is [0.167, 0.188]. Printed HI_c relative to Human-Only: treatment -0.050 (-5.0%); control 0.000 (baseline). HI_c is a transformation of dispersion, not a separate outcome or a between-AI-arm effect; higher HI_c means more similarity, opposite to D_c. The paper explicitly treats these summaries as descriptive and prints no difference, difference SE, contrast CI, or between-condition test. The bootstrap resampling unit and procedure are not specified sufficiently to establish participant-level contrast uncertainty. Each condition is an essay set; no pair-specific total number of people or sets is printed.

notes: Extracted independently by A on 2026-10-11. Read the entire markdown in order, including references and all appendices, then checked cited PDF pages with pymupdf. All PDF page numbers cited here match the printed page numbers. Only comparisons among the first-phase Human-Only, Standard Chatbot, and Engage-to-Unlock arms are randomized; the study-level analyzed count retains the paper's overall count, including Time-Matched Unlock. Participants were analyzed after attention-check exclusions. The study-level AI role is other because the protocol combines open generative chat with an initial coaching policy in Engage-to-Unlock; the arm descriptions specify that difference. Prior cross-paper sample reuse is not stated, and the second phase explicitly excluded first-phase participants. All extracted outputs are the final assisted-task essays; the subsequent passage task does not produce creative output. Dispersion establishes eligibility; the ancillary structural, lexical, and semantic-location measures are not relabeled as rated creativity. Numeric full-arm summaries are retained for every available randomized arm pair, including pairs omitted from the screening map; this does not imply a pairwise significance test. Qualitative and figure-only findings remain as records with null numeric outcome fields. The PCA components grouped in the form are separated for extraction. The homogenization index remains alongside dispersion in notes, not as a duplicate outcome. For dispersion, treatment-arm intervals occupy the generic CI fields and control-arm intervals are preserved in notes with the same table-row provenance. No sums, differences, standard errors, standardized effects, proportions, or event counts were calculated; printed precision and signs are retained in source quotes. All n_total and n_units fields are null because the source does not print totals for the individual extracted arm pairs.
